sheets.name: run_1
sheets.action: running (his move loop): a gunslinger's run, the LEGS SWAPPING every half cycle (left foot forward, then right foot forward), the body bobbing with each stride, the coat tails flowing back
sheets.weapons: Two pistols as in the design, one in EACH hand in every frame: the NEAR hand (image left in the design, the one held upright) keeps its pistol, the FAR hand (pointing forward in the design) keeps its own - never both in one hand, never swapped, never dropped; the pistols' shape, size and colours as in the design. Each pistol pointed exactly as the pale figure's hand holds it.
